evidence.evidence_text: We explore several methods to mitigate this deficiency, such as natural language prompts, few-shot demonstrations, and fine-tuning.
Specifically, we construct a new dataset MathTrap by introducing carefully designed logical traps into the problem descriptions of MATH and GSM8K.
